_description: Mapping from Title Case label stage names to canonical snake_case used by FieldNamer. Applied to dataset/extracted/*.json in sub-PR G2.

new_canonicals_proposed.rationale: Appears consistently after Sewing and before Final Inspection across 5 files. In garment manufacturing CIP = Cutting/Checking In Process — an inline quality gate distinct from the terminal Final Inspection. No existing canonical covers mid-production QA.

A distinct wet-processing stage (colour dyeing of knitted fabric or yarn) that is different from 'washing'. Appears in a knitwear supplier flow: Yarn I/H → Knit → Dyeing → Finishing. Mapping to 'washing' would be semantically incorrect.

Tracks the date goods depart factory for export. The PLI-level field ex_factory_date captures the planned date, but as a stage it tracks both planned and actual departure. No existing stage canonical covers shipment dispatch. 'final_inspection' is the wrong semantic.

new_canonicals_proposed.rationale: Appears in knitwear-specific flow after Yarn I/H, representing the knitting production stage. Mapping to 'fabric' would conflate the material-receipt stage with the manufacturing step. Needs its own canonical.

Tracks arrival of trims (buttons, zippers, labels, etc.) at the factory — distinct from fabric inhouse. Appears in 9 files at high occurrence (281). Mapping to in_house_fabric_send would conflate trims with fabric, losing a critical supply-chain distinction.
